title: 4/12 Hetzner cron script: the 03:00 chain's log redirect bound only to its last command, dropping pull/build/sync-to-r2 output (and sync ran before preview)
missing_evidence: which crontab the box ran at 2026-04-13 03:00 ET: the d5c466c layout (committed 11:46, replaced in the script at 12:31 on 4/12) or the 715c932 subshell layout; no April crontab history is in the repo (B1 holds only the final crontab and the 9/14 snapshot)
~/logs/cron.log for the 2026-04-13 and 2026-04-14 03:00 runs, if retained (Phase 2, B1/B2): whether pull/build lines appear
tier_reason: observability of the 03:00 data chain only (a failed step would be invisible in cron.log); no delivery or state effect of its own; the script was corrected 45 min after it was written

contract.text: Every step of the 03:00 chain (data pull, build, preview, sync-to-r2) writes its output to ~/logs/cron.log, and an R2 sync failure cannot block the morning preview.
contract.source: scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh 3am-chain comment and 715c932 body; design §6.2 V7 (each cron log's own markers)

mechanism.text: in `pull && build && sync-to-r2 && preview >> cron.log 2>&1` sh binds the redirect to the last command only, so pull/build/sync output went to cron's own stdout/mail instead of cron.log
the same line ran sync-to-r2 before preview joined by &&, so an R2/credential failure would have skipped the preview pick

watchdog.trigger: by 04:00 ET, cron.log lacks a completion (or error) marker for any step of that night's 03:00 chain (pull, build, preview, sync-to-r2)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: each step's success marker (or an explicit error) is in cron.log for the night and the R2 manifest time advances

evidence.what: the prior layout 'was silently dropping pull/build/sync output' because the redirect binds to the last command; the chain is reordered to preview before sync and wrapped in a subshell
the first reproducible Hetzner crontab (4/12 11:46) carried the unwrapped pull && build && sync-to-r2 && preview >> cron.log line
context (I-019's contemporaneous report): the manually installed crontab used `source .env` under dash and every job died on its first line since the 4/11 cutover, so no 03:00 chain ran before 4/12
through 4/14 every 03:00 run stopped at `bts data pull` with a missing-option error and nobody noticed until a manual probe; where the error was read is not stated

occurrences.label: candidate: 03:00 chain runs under the d5c466c layout, if it stayed installed (first possible 2026-04-13 03:00 ET)

notes: disposition changed from the row's DL: before d5c466c the manual crontab died at `source` (nothing ran), and the defective script layout lived 45 min (11:46-12:31 on 4/12) with no 03:00 run inside that window; it fired only if the operator installed d5c466c and did not reinstall 715c932 before 4/13 03:00. If it never ran, this is a pre_ship_exclusion
